Four different left edges (124/64/244/0) across 1440-scroll-25.jpg and 1440-rm-full.jpg (-0.5). Empty dashed tray bar in the story (1440-scroll-25.jpg) and dead gold block under the builder grid (1440-rm-full.jpg) (-0.5). Tone alternation is good.

mobile.notes: 390-first.jpg: good fold, sticky Call/Build bar. 390-rm-full.jpg: builder stacks cleanly, 48px controls, no overflow per render.json; review cards and service icons touch the left screen edge (covered by layout mustFix, -0.5); triage chips stack one per row, ~300px before the answer box.

a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg and 390-rm-full.jpg show all content with reduced motion. MustFix: 1440-scroll-25.jpg inactive story step body text measured ~3.5:1 (rgb 115,141,140 on #1C3A38), below 4.5:1 for 16px text.

motion.notes: Motion-on full page ~2000px taller than 1440-rm-full.jpg: pinned scrubbed story; 1440-scroll-25.jpg shows step state advancing. Builder, triage, photo tabs and stepped form are real interactions. The story frame shows static tools over an empty tray, so the lift-into-tray payoff is not visible (-0.5).

wow.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg: punch-list builder + 'Your tray' receipt is an on-thesis tool, and the brown sketch wall is memorable. Both trays shown empty ('0 H', empty dashed bar in 1440-scroll-25.jpg), so first sight is a blank receipt (-0.5).

polish.notes: 1440-first.jpg/1024-first.jpg clipped tags read unfinished; 1440-rm-full.jpg town pills with zero gap, 'reviews' orphan; 1440-scroll-50.jpg 'Price it' links at uneven heights. Favicon/OG/footer disclaimer clean.

mustFix.problem: Hour hang-tags clipped by their tiles: 'TV MOUNT 1.5-2.5 H' and 'RE-CAULK 1.5-2.5 H' lose the H at 1440 and read '1.5-' at 1024
mustFix.fix: Size tags to content (white-space:nowrap; width:max-content; no overflow:hidden on the tile); below 1100px break the hours onto a second tag line instead of truncating

mustFix.problem: Left grid column starts at x=0: rules, icons and review cards touch the viewport edge while the h2 sits at 124px (20px on phone)
mustFix.fix: Put both grids in the same container as their heading (max-width 1192px, margin-inline auto, padding-inline var(--gutter))

mustFix.problem: Inactive step body text measured ~3.5:1 on #1C3A38, below 4.5:1
mustFix.fix: Stop dimming text with opacity; keep inactive text ≥4.5:1 (e.g. #B9C6BF) and mark the active step with the gold number or a rule

elevate.move: Make the hero the tool itself: tapping a hero hang-tag lifts that tool off its peg and starts a running hours tally under the h1, so the first screen proves 'See the hours' instead of illustrating it.

Put the whole page on one pegboard module: every band, card edge and services rule snaps to the same peg-hole columns, so the page reads as one workshop wall instead of bands with four different left edges.
